data.name: Ghaneem
data.gender_notes: Ghaneem is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghanana' which means to give or bestow generously. In Islamic context, it refers to the quality of being kind, giving, and charitable. The name Ghaneem carries the meaning “Generous, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaneem usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the virtue of generosity and kindness, which is highly valued in Islam.
data.etymology: Ghaneem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaneem total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: غني
in_arabic.meaning: غني يعني الغني والثري في اللغة العربية و في الدين الإسلامي
in_arabic.long_meaning: غني هو اسم يدل على الغنى والثراء، ولكنه في اللغة العربية و في سياق الدين الإسلامي، يرتبط بالغنى الروحي والأخلاقي. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطيه أهمية دينية وروحية كبيرة.

in_urdu.name: غنی
in_urdu.meaning: غنی مطلب ہے ثروت مند، امیر، مالک، اور اسلامی نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: غنی ایک ایسا نام ہے جو ثروت مندی اور امارت کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق عربی زبان کی جڑوں سے ہے جن سے الغنی اور الفتوحات کے مفاہم اخذ ہوئے ہیں۔ اسلامی تقليد میں، یہ نام محبت، كرم، اور شفقت کی خصوصیات کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ग़नी

The name has been used historically across various Muslim cultures to denote someone who is not only materially wealthy but also spiritually rich.
